azkar.0: Praise be to Allah who gave us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
azkar.1: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things. Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is Most Great. There is no power nor might except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great. My Lord, forgive me.
azkar.2: Praise be to Allah who restored my health, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.
azkar.3: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of night and day are signs for those of understanding — the closing verses of Sūrat Āl 'Imrān (190–200).
azkar.4: Praise be to Allah who clothed me with this garment and provided it for me with no power or strength on my part.
azkar.5: O Allah, Yours is the praise; You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.
azkar.6: May it wear out and may Allah replace it.
azkar.7: Wear anew, live praiseworthily, and die a martyr.
azkar.9: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female devils.
azkar.12: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.
azkar.13: O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves.
azkar.14: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
azkar.15: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power nor might except with Allah.
azkar.16: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I stray or be led astray, lest I slip or be made to slip, lest I wrong or be wronged, lest I behave foolishly or be treated foolishly.
azkar.17: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we rely. Then let him greet his household with peace.
azkar.18: O Allah, place light in my heart, light on my tongue, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light above me, light below me, light on my right, light on my left, light before me and light behind me; place light in my soul and make my light great.
azkar.19: Entering with the right foot, he says: I seek refuge in Allah the Almighty, in His noble Face and His eternal authority, from the accursed Satan. In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
azkar.20: Leaving with the left foot, he says: In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty. O Allah, protect me from the accursed Satan.
azkar.21: He repeats after the caller to prayer, except at "Come to prayer" and "Come to success", where he says: There is no power nor might except with Allah.
azkar.22: And I too bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. I am content with Allah as Lord, with Muhammad as Messenger, and with Islam as religion.
azkar.23: He sends blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ after answering the caller to prayer.
azkar.24: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer to be established, grant Muhammad the intercession and the favour, and raise him to the praised station You have promised him.
azkar.25: He supplicates for himself between the adhan and the iqama, for supplication at that time is not rejected.
azkar.26: O Allah, distance me from my sins as You have distanced the East from the West. O Allah, cleanse me of my sins as a white garment is cleansed of filth. O Allah, wash away my sins with snow, water and hail.
azkar.27: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. Blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god but You.
azkar.28: I have turned my face to the One who created the heavens and the earth, upright, and I am not of the polytheists. Truly my prayer, my sacrifice, my life and my death are for Allah, Lord of the worlds, no partner has He.
azkar.29: O Allah, Lord of Gabriel, Michael and Isrāfīl, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen: You judge between Your servants concerning that in which they differ. Guide me to the truth in what is disputed, by Your leave.
azkar.30: Allah is Most Great indeed, praise be to Allah abundantly, and glory be to Allah morning and evening. I seek refuge in Allah from Satan: from his arrogance, his poetry and his madness.
azkar.31: O Allah, Yours is the praise. You are the Light of the heavens and the earth and all within them. Yours is the praise; You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all within them. You are the Truth, Your promise is true, Your word is true, and the meeting with You is true.
azkar.32: Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great.
azkar.33: Glory be to You, O Allah our Lord, and praise be to You. O Allah, forgive me.
azkar.34: Perfect and Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
azkar.35: O Allah, to You I have bowed, in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. My hearing, my sight, my mind, my bones and my sinews are humbled before You.
azkar.36: Glory be to the Possessor of might, dominion, grandeur and majesty.
azkar.37: Allah hears the one who praises Him.
azkar.38: Our Lord, Yours is the praise — abundant, good and blessed praise.
azkar.39: Filling the heavens, filling the earth, filling what is between them, and filling whatever else You will. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold, and no wealth avails its owner against You.
azkar.40: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.
azkar.41: Glory be to You, O Allah our Lord, and praise be to You. O Allah, forgive me.
azkar.42: Perfect and Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
azkar.43: O Allah, to You I have prostrated, in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. My face has prostrated to the One who created it, fashioned it, and gave it hearing and sight. Blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
azkar.44: Glory be to the Possessor of might, dominion, grandeur and majesty.
azkar.45: O Allah, forgive me all my sins: the small and the great, the first and the last, the open and the secret.
azkar.46: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your displeasure, in Your pardon from Your punishment, and I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise; You are as You have praised Yourself.
azkar.47: My Lord, forgive me. My Lord, forgive me.
azkar.48: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, support me, protect me, provide for me and raise me.
azkar.49: My face has prostrated to the One who created it and gave it hearing and sight by His power and strength. Blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
azkar.50: O Allah, record for me a reward with You for this, remove a burden from me by it, store it up for me with You, and accept it from me as You accepted it from Your servant David.
azkar.51: All greetings, prayers and good things are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
azkar.52: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Abraham and the family of Abraham; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Abraham and the family of Abraham; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
azkar.53: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, his wives and his offspring, as You sent blessings upon the family of Abraham; and bless Muhammad, his wives and his offspring, as You blessed the family of Abraham. You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
azkar.54: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of Hellfire, from the trials of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah.
azkar.55: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the trial of the False Messiah, and from the trials of life and death. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and from debt.
azkar.56: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself, and none forgives sins but You. So forgive me with forgiveness from You and have mercy on me; indeed You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
azkar.57: O Allah, forgive me what I have done before and after, what I have concealed and declared, what I have done to excess, and what You know better than I. You are the One who brings forward and the One who puts back; there is no god but You.
azkar.58: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.
azkar.59: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness, from cowardice, from being returned to feeble old age, from the trials of this world and from the punishment of the grave.
azkar.60: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.
azkar.61: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive so long as You know life to be good for me, and take me when You know death to be better for me. O Allah, I ask You for awe of You in private and in public, for a word of truth in contentment and in anger, for moderation in wealth and in poverty, and for a delight that never ends.
azkar.62: O Allah, I ask You, for You are the One, the Only, the Eternal Refuge, who neither begets nor is born, and to whom none is equal, that You forgive my sins; indeed You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
azkar.63: O Allah, I ask You, for Yours is the praise, there is no god but You alone without partner, the Bestower, O Originator of the heavens and the earth, O Possessor of majesty and honour, O Ever-Living, O Sustainer — I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.
azkar.64: O Allah, I ask You, bearing witness that You are Allah, there is no god but You, the One, the Eternal Refuge, who neither begets nor is born, and to whom none is equal.
azkar.65: I seek Allah's forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.
azkar.66: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things (three times). O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and no wealth avails its owner against You.
azkar.67: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things. There is no power nor might except with Allah. There is no god but Allah, and we worship none but Him. His is the favour, His is the bounty, and His is the excellent praise. There is no god but Allah, sincere to Him in religion even though the disbelievers dislike it.
azkar.68: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, and Allah is Most Great (thirty-three times each). There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things.

azkar.70: Āyat al-Kursī (al-Baqara 255) — the Verse of the Throne, recited after each obligatory prayer.
azkar.71: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is capable of all things.
azkar.72: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision and accepted deeds.
azkar.73: Jābir ibn 'Abdullāh said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to teach us the istikhāra for all matters as he taught us a chapter of the Qur'an, saying: when one of you intends a matter, let him pray two units outside the obligatory prayer, then say: O Allah, I seek Your guidance by Your knowledge and Your power…
azkar.74: Praise be to Allah alone, and prayers and peace be upon the one after whom there is no prophet.
azkar.75: Āyat al-Kursī (al-Baqara 255) — the Verse of the Throne.

His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good that follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the misery of old age.
azkar.78: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
azkar.79: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I keep Your covenant and Your promise as much as I can. azkar.122: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, saying: "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say: "We hear and we obey. We seek Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the final destination." Allah does not charge a soul except with that within its capacity. It will have the consequence of what good it has gained, and it will bear the consequence of what evil it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people." (al-Baqara 2:285–286)
azkar.123: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it. If You take my soul, have mercy on it, and if You send it back, protect it with that by which You protect Your righteous servants.
azkar.124: O Allah, You created my soul and You take it back. Its death and its life belong to You. If You keep it alive, protect it, and if You cause it to die, forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for well-being.
azkar.125: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
azkar.126: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
azkar.130: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the Mighty Throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the grain and the date-stone, Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel and the Criterion (the Qur'an): I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything whose forelock You hold. O Allah, You are the First, and there is nothing before You; You are the Last, and there is nothing after You; You are the Manifest, and there is nothing above You; You are the Hidden, and there is nothing beyond You. Settle our debts for us and free us from poverty.
azkar.131: Praise be to Allah who has fed us, given us drink, sufficed us and given us shelter; for how many are there who have none to suffice them and none to give them shelter.
azkar.132: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Master of all things: I bear witness that there is no god but You. azkar.135: There is no god but Allah, the One, the Prevailing, Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Almighty, the Oft-Forgiving.
azkar.136: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and His punishment, from the evil of His servants, and from the promptings of the devils and from their presence.

azkar.142: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, grant me well-being among those You have granted well-being, take me into Your care among those You have taken into Your care, bless me in what You have given, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed. For You decree and none decrees over You. Indeed, the one You befriend is never humiliated, [and the one You take as an enemy is never honoured]. Blessed are You, our Lord, and Exalted.
azkar.143: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your displeasure, in Your pardon from Your punishment, and I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise; You are as You have praised Yourself.
azkar.144: O Allah, You alone we worship; to You we pray and prostrate; towards You we strive and hasten. We hope for Your mercy and we fear Your punishment; indeed Your punishment will overtake the disbelievers. O Allah, we seek Your help and Your forgiveness, we praise You with all good, we do not deny You, we believe in You, we submit to You, and we disown whoever disbelieves in You.
azkar.145: Glory be to the King, the Most Holy.
azkar.146: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand; Your judgement upon me is assured, and Your decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every name that is Yours, with which You have named Yourself, or revealed in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept with Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen, that You make the Qur'an the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the banisher of my sadness and the remover of my worry.
azkar.147: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, and from the burden of debt and being overpowered by men.
azkar.148: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
azkar.149: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye, and set right all my affairs. There is no god but You.
azkar.150: There is no god but You; glory be to You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
azkar.151: Allah, Allah is my Lord; I do not associate anything with Him.
azkar.152: O Allah, we place You before them, and we seek refuge in You from their evil.
azkar.153: O Allah, You are my support and You are my helper. By You I move, by You I charge, and by You I fight.
azkar.154: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
azkar.155: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Mighty Throne, be my protector against so-and-so son of so-and-so and his allies among Your creation, lest any of them should harm me or transgress against me. Mighty is the one under Your protection, glorious is Your praise, and there is no god but You.
azkar.156: Allah is Most Great. Allah is mightier than all His creation. Allah is mightier than what I fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, besides whom there is no god, who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His permission, from the evil of Your servant so-and-so, and his soldiers, followers and supporters among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my protector against their evil. Glorious is Your praise, mighty is the one under Your protection, blessed is Your name, and there is no god other than You.
azkar.157: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift in reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and shake them.
azkar.158: O Allah, suffice me against them however You will.
azkar.160: He stops dwelling on what he was being whispered about.
azkar.161: He says: I believe in Allah and His messengers.
azkar.162: He recites the words of Allah the Exalted: "He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing." (al-Hadid 57:3)
azkar.163: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful against what You have made unlawful, and by Your bounty make me independent of all besides You.
azkar.164: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, and from the burden of debt and being overpowered by men.
azkar.165: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan — and spit lightly to your left (three times).
azkar.166: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make the difficult easy if You will.
azkar.167: There is no servant who commits a sin, then purifies himself well, then stands and prays two units of prayer, then seeks Allah's forgiveness, except that Allah forgives him.
azkar.168: Seeking refuge in Allah from him.
azkar.170: Remembrance of Allah and recitation of the Qur'an.
azkar.171: Allah has decreed, and what He wills He does.
azkar.172: May Allah bless you in what you have been given; may you thank the Giver; may the child reach maturity, and may you be granted his righteousness. The one congratulated replies: May Allah bless you and shower blessings upon you, may Allah reward you with good, grant you the like of it, and make your reward abundant.
azkar.173: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to seek protection for al-Hasan and al-Husayn, may Allah be pleased with them, saying: I seek protection for you both in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.
azkar.174: No harm; it is a purification, if Allah wills.
azkar.175: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to cure you.
azkar.176: The Prophet ﷺ said: When a man visits his sick Muslim brother, he walks among the harvest of Paradise until he sits down. When he sits, mercy covers him. If it is in the morning, seventy thousand angels pray for him until the evening; and if it is in the evening, seventy thousand angels pray for him until the morning.
azkar.177: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, and join me with the highest companions.
azkar.178: At the time of his death the Prophet ﷺ began to dip his hands in water and wipe his face with them, saying: There is no god but Allah; indeed death has its agonies.
azkar.179: There is no god but Allah, and Allah is Most Great. There is no god but Allah alone. There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. There is no god but Allah; His is the dominion and His is the praise. There is no god but Allah, and there is no power nor might except with Allah.
azkar.180: Whoever's last words are "There is no god but Allah" will enter Paradise.
azkar.181: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it for me with something better.
azkar.182: O Allah, forgive so-and-so (mention his name), raise his rank among the rightly guided, be a successor to him among those he leaves behind, and forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds. Make his grave spacious for him and fill it with light.
azkar.183: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, grant him well-being and pardon him. Honour his abode and make his entrance spacious. Wash him with water, snow and hail, and cleanse him of sins as a white garment is cleansed of filth. Give him a home better than his home, a family better than his family, and a spouse better than his spouse. Admit him into Paradise and protect him from the punishment of the grave [and the punishment of the Fire].
azkar.184: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whoever of us You keep alive, keep him alive upon Islam, and whoever of us You take, take him upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not lead us astray after him.
azkar.185: O Allah, so-and-so son of so-and-so is under Your care and in the rope of Your protection, so protect him from the trial of the grave and the punishment of the Fire. You are the One who fulfils promises and the Truth, so forgive him and have mercy on him; indeed You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
azkar.186: O Allah, Your servant, the son of Your maidservant, is in need of Your mercy, and You have no need to punish him. If he did good, increase his good deeds, and if he did wrong, pass over his wrongdoing.
azkar.187: O Allah, protect him from the punishment of the grave. And if one says: "O Allah, make him a forerunner and a treasure for his parents, and an intercessor whose intercession is accepted. O Allah, make their scales heavy through him and make their reward great through him. Join him with the righteous believers, place him in the care of Abraham, and by Your mercy protect him from the punishment of Hellfire. Give him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive our predecessors, our children who went before us, and those who preceded us in faith" — that is good.
azkar.188: O Allah, make him for us a forerunner, a precursor and a reward.
azkar.189: To Allah belongs what He took and to Him belongs what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed term… so be patient and hope for the reward. And if one says: "May Allah make your reward great, grant you good consolation, and forgive your deceased" — that is good.
azkar.190: In the name of Allah and according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.
azkar.191: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, make him firm.
azkar.192: Peace be upon you, O inhabitants of these dwellings, among the believers and the Muslims. We will, if Allah wills, join you. [May Allah have mercy on those of us who have gone ahead and those who come later.] I ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.
azkar.193: O Allah, I ask You for its good and I seek refuge in You from its evil.
azkar.194: O Allah, I ask You for its good, the good within it and the good it was sent with; and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil within it and the evil it was sent with.
azkar.195: Glory be to the One whom the thunder glorifies with His praise, as do the angels out of awe of Him.
azkar.196: O Allah, give us rain that is relieving, wholesome and fruitful, beneficial and not harmful, soon and not delayed.
azkar.197: O Allah, relieve us. O Allah, relieve us. O Allah, relieve us.
azkar.198: O Allah, give water to Your servants and Your livestock, spread Your mercy, and revive Your dead land.
azkar.199: O Allah, let it be a beneficial rain.
azkar.200: We have been given rain by the bounty of Allah and His mercy.
azkar.201: O Allah, around us and not upon us. O Allah, upon the hills and the mountains, the valleys and the places where trees grow.
azkar.202: Allah is Most Great. O Allah, bring it upon us with security and faith, with safety and Islam, and with success in what You love and are pleased with, our Lord. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.
azkar.203: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
azkar.204: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which encompasses all things to forgive me.
azkar.205: When one of you eats food, let him say: In the name of Allah. If he forgets at the beginning, let him say: In the name of Allah, at its beginning and at its end.
azkar.206: Whomever Allah feeds with food, let him say: O Allah, bless it for us and feed us with what is better than it. And whomever Allah gives milk to drink, let him say: O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.
azkar.207: Praise be to Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any power or strength on my part.
azkar.208: Praise be to Allah, abundant, good and blessed praise; praise that is never [insufficient, nor] abandoned, nor can it be dispensed with, our Lord.
azkar.209: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided for them, forgive them and have mercy on them.
azkar.210: O Allah, feed the one who fed me, and give drink to the one who gave me drink.
azkar.211: May those who fast break their fast with you, may the righteous eat your food, and may the angels pray for you.
azkar.212: When one of you is invited, let him accept. If he is fasting, let him pray (for them), and if he is not fasting, let him eat. The meaning of "let him pray" is: let him supplicate.
azkar.213: I am fasting, I am fasting.
azkar.214: O Allah, bless us in our fruit, bless us in our city, bless us in our ṣāʿ, and bless us in our mudd.
azkar.215: When one of you sneezes, let him say: Praise be to Allah. And let his brother or companion say to him: May Allah have mercy on you. When he says to him "May Allah have mercy on you", let him reply: May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.
azkar.216: May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.
azkar.217: May Allah bless you, shower His blessings upon you, and join you both in goodness.
azkar.218: When one of you marries a woman or buys a servant, let him say: O Allah, I ask You for her good and the good of the nature You created her with, and I seek refuge in You from her evil and the evil of the nature You created her with. And when he buys a camel, let him take hold of the top of its hump and say the same.
azkar.219: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep Satan away from us, and keep Satan away from what You provide for us.
azkar.220: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.
azkar.221: Praise be to Allah who has spared me from what He has afflicted you with, and has greatly favoured me over much of what He has created.
azkar.222: Ibn 'Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both, said: It would be counted for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a single sitting, a hundred times before he stood up: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance; indeed You are the Accepter of repentance, the Oft-Forgiving.
azkar.223: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
azkar.225: May Allah reward you with good.
azkar.226: Whoever memorises ten verses from the beginning of Sūrat al-Kahf will be protected from the Dajjāl (False Messiah); and also seeking refuge in Allah from his trial after the final tashahhud of every prayer.
azkar.227: May the One for whose sake you love me love you.
azkar.228: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth.
azkar.229: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth. The reward for a loan is only praise and repayment.
azkar.230: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowingly associating anything with You, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do not know.
azkar.231: And may Allah bless you too.
azkar.232: O Allah, there is no omen except Your decree, there is no good except Your good, and there is no god other than You.
azkar.233: In the name of Allah, and praise be to Allah. "Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, and we could not have otherwise subdued it. And indeed we, to our Lord, will surely return." (az-Zukhruf 43:13–14) Praise be to Allah, praise be to Allah, praise be to Allah. Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great. Glory be to You, O Allah; I have wronged myself, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.
azkar.234: Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great. "Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, and we could not have otherwise subdued it. And indeed we, to our Lord, will surely return." (az-Zukhruf 43:13–14) O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance for us. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Guardian of the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, from a distressing sight, and from an evil turn of events in wealth and family. And when he returns he says the same and adds: We return, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.
azkar.235: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they shade, Lord of the seven earths and all that they carry, Lord of the devils and all whom they misguide, Lord of the winds and all that they scatter: I ask You for the good of this town, the good of its people and the good within it, and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of its people and the evil within it.
azkar.236: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is Ever-Living and does not die. In His hand is all good, and He is capable of all things.
azkar.238: I entrust you to Allah, whose trusts are never lost.
azkar.239: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trustworthiness and the final outcomes of your deeds.
azkar.240: May Allah provide you with piety as your provision, forgive your sins, and make good easy for you wherever you are.
azkar.241: Jābir, may Allah be pleased with him, said: When we went up we would say "Allah is Most Great", and when we went down we would say "Glory be to Allah".
azkar.242: May a witness bear witness to our praise of Allah and His good favours upon us. Our Lord, accompany us and bestow Your favour upon us, as we seek refuge in Allah from the Fire.
azkar.243: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
azkar.244: On every high ground he says "Allah is Most Great" three times, then says: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things. We return, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord. Allah has fulfilled His promise, helped His servant, and defeated the confederates alone.
azkar.245: When something pleasing came to the Prophet ﷺ he would say: Praise be to Allah, by whose favour good things are completed. And when something displeasing came to him he would say: Praise be to Allah in every circumstance.
azkar.246: The Prophet ﷺ said: Whoever sends one prayer of blessing upon me, Allah sends ten upon him because of it.
azkar.247: And he ﷺ said: Do not make my grave a place of festivity, but send prayers of blessing upon me, for your prayers reach me wherever you are.
azkar.248: And he ﷺ said: The miser is the one in whose presence I am mentioned and he does not send prayers of blessing upon me.
azkar.249: And he ﷺ said: Allah has angels who roam the earth, conveying to me the greetings of peace from my nation.
azkar.250: And he ﷺ said: There is no one who greets me with peace except that Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greeting.
azkar.251: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I not guide you to something which, if you do it, you will love one another? Spread the greeting of peace among yourselves.
azkar.252: Three things — whoever combines them has combined faith: being just with yourself, offering the greeting of peace to everyone, and spending in charity even when in need.
azkar.253: 'Abdullāh ibn 'Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both, narrated that a man asked the Prophet ﷺ: Which aspect of Islam is best? He said: That you feed people, and greet with peace those you know and those you do not know.
azkar.254: When the People of the Book greet you with peace, say: "And upon you."
azkar.255: When you hear the crowing of roosters, ask Allah of His bounty, for they have seen an angel. And when you hear the braying of a donkey, seek refuge in Allah from Satan, for it has seen a devil.
azkar.256: When you hear dogs barking and donkeys braying at night, seek refuge in Allah from them, for they see what you do not see.
azkar.257: The Prophet ﷺ said: O Allah, whichever believer I have insulted, make that a means of drawing him near to You on the Day of Resurrection.
azkar.258: The Prophet ﷺ said: If one of you must praise his companion, let him say: I consider so-and-so to be such — and Allah is his Reckoner, and I do not attest anyone's purity before Allah — I consider him to be such and such, if he knows that of him.
azkar.259: O Allah, do not take me to account for what they say, forgive me for what they do not know, [and make me better than what they think].
azkar.260: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am; You have no partner; here I am. Indeed, all praise, blessings and dominion are Yours. You have no partner.
azkar.261: The Prophet ﷺ performed tawāf around the House on a camel; every time he came to the Corner (the Black Stone) he pointed to it with something he had with him and said "Allah is Most Great".
azkar.262: "Our Lord, give us in this world good and in the Hereafter good, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire." (al-Baqara 2:201)
azkar.263: When the Prophet ﷺ approached aṣ-Ṣafā he recited: "Indeed, aṣ-Ṣafā and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah" (al-Baqara 2:158) — "I begin with what Allah began with." So he began with aṣ-Ṣafā and climbed it until he could see the House. He faced the qibla, declared Allah's oneness and greatness, and said: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things. There is no god but Allah alone; He fulfilled His promise, helped His servant, and defeated the confederates alone. Then he supplicated in between, saying this three times. And in the hadith: he did at al-Marwah as he had done at aṣ-Ṣafā.
azkar.264: The Prophet ﷺ said: The best supplication is the supplication on the Day of 'Arafah, and the best that I and the prophets before me have said is: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things.
azkar.265: The Prophet ﷺ rode al-Qaswā' until he reached al-Mash'ar al-Harām. He faced the qibla and supplicated to Allah, declared His greatness, said "There is no god but Allah" and declared His oneness. He remained standing until the daylight was very bright, then departed before sunrise.
azkar.266: He says "Allah is Most Great" with each pebble he throws at the three Jamarāt. Then he moves forward and stands supplicating, facing the qibla and raising his hands, after the first and second Jamra. As for Jamrat al-'Aqaba, he stones it, saying "Allah is Most Great" with each pebble, then leaves without standing there.
azkar.269: Whenever something came to the Prophet ﷺ that pleased him or by which he was gladdened, he would fall down in prostration in gratitude to Allah, Blessed and Exalted.
azkar.270: Place your hand on the part of your body that hurts and say "In the name of Allah" three times, and say seven times: I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and what I fear.
azkar.271: When one of you sees something he admires in his brother, in himself or in his wealth, [let him supplicate for blessing for it], for the evil eye is real.
azkar.272: There is no god but Allah!
azkar.273: In the name of Allah, and Allah is Most Great. [O Allah, it is from You and for You.] O Allah, accept it from me.
azkar.274: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, which neither the righteous nor the wicked can transgress, from the evil of what He has created, made and spread; from the evil of what descends from the sky and the evil of what ascends to it; from the evil of what He has spread on the earth and the evil of what comes out of it; from the evil of the trials of the night and the day; and from the evil of every night visitor, except a visitor who comes with good, O Most Merciful.
azkar.275: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: By Allah, I seek Allah's forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance more than seventy times a day.
azkar.276: And he ﷺ said: O people, turn to Allah in repentance, for I turn to Him in repentance a hundred times a day.
azkar.277: And he ﷺ said: Whoever says "I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, besides whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I turn to Him in repentance", Allah will forgive him, even if he had fled from the battlefield.
azkar.278: And he ﷺ said: The Lord is closest to the servant in the last part of the night, so if you are able to be among those who remember Allah at that hour, then do so.
azkar.279: And he ﷺ said: The closest a servant is to his Lord is when he is prostrating, so supplicate much.
azkar.280: And he ﷺ said: A covering comes over my heart, and I seek Allah's forgiveness a hundred times a day.
azkar.281: He ﷺ said: Whoever says "Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him" a hundred times in a day, his sins will be wiped away even if they are like the foam of the sea.
azkar.282: And he ﷺ said: Whoever says ten times "There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things" will be like one who freed four souls from the descendants of Ishmael.
azkar.283: And he ﷺ said: Two words that are light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him; glory be to Allah the Mighty.
azkar.284: And he ﷺ said: That I say "Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is Most Great" is more beloved to me than everything upon which the sun rises.
azkar.285: And he ﷺ said: Is any one of you unable to earn a thousand good deeds every day? One of those sitting with him asked: How can one of us earn a thousand good deeds? He said: He glorifies Allah a hundred times, and a thousand good deeds are written for him, or a thousand sins are wiped away from him.
azkar.286: Whoever says "Glory be to Allah the Mighty and praise be to Him", a palm tree is planted for him in Paradise.
azkar.287: And he ﷺ said: O 'Abdullāh ibn Qays, shall I not direct you to a treasure from the treasures of Paradise? I said: Yes, O Messenger of Allah. He said: Say: There is no power nor might except with Allah.
azkar.288: And he ﷺ said: The most beloved words to Allah are four: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is Most Great. It does not matter which of them you begin with.
azkar.289: A Bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: Teach me words that I may say. He said: Say: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. Allah is Most Great, greatly; praise be to Allah, abundantly; glory be to Allah, Lord of the worlds; there is no power nor might except with Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise. He said: These are for my Lord, so what is for me? He said: Say: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me and provide for me.
azkar.290: When a man embraced Islam, the Prophet ﷺ would teach him the prayer and then instruct him to supplicate with these words: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being and provide for me.
azkar.291: Indeed, the best supplication is "Praise be to Allah", and the best remembrance is "There is no god but Allah".
azkar.292: The enduring good deeds are: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is Most Great, and there is no power nor might except with Allah.
azkar.293: 'Abdullāh ibn 'Amr, may Allah be pleased with them both, said: I saw the Prophet ﷺ counting the tasbīh on his fingers — and in another narration: with his right hand.
azkar.294: The Prophet ﷺ said: When night falls — or when evening comes — keep your children in, for the devils spread out at that time. When an hour of the night has passed, let them go. Close the doors and mention the name of Allah, for Satan does not open a closed door. Tie up your water-skins and mention the name of Allah. Cover your vessels and mention the name of Allah, even if only by placing something across them. And put out your lamps.
azkar.295: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief; I seek refuge in You from incapacity and laziness; I seek refuge in You from cowardice and miserliness; and I seek refuge in You from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men.
azkar.296: O Allah, we seek refuge in You from knowingly associating anything with You, and we seek Your forgiveness for what we do not know.
azkar.297: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, besides whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I turn to Him in repentance.
azkar.298: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, saying: "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say: "We hear and we obey. We seek Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the final destination." Allah does not charge a soul except with that within its capacity. It will have the consequence of what good it has gained, and it will bear the consequence of what evil it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people." (al-Baqara 2:285–286)
azkar.299: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him — as many as the number of His creation, as pleases Him, as the weight of His Throne, and as the ink of His words.
azkar.300: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, besides whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I turn to Him in repentance.
azkar.301: O Allah, we seek refuge in You from knowingly associating anything with You, and we seek Your forgiveness for what we do not know.
azkar.302: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief; I seek refuge in You from incapacity and laziness; I seek refuge in You from cowardice and miserliness; and I seek refuge in You from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men.
azkar.303: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

asmaallah_desc.1: Abundant in mercy. This name is exclusive to Allah, Mighty and Majestic; it is not permissible to call anyone other than Allah 'Rahman'. His mercy encompasses all things, and He is the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.
asmaallah_desc.2: He is the One who bestows blessings forever and grants favour always; His mercy never ends.
asmaallah_desc.3: He is Allah, the King of kings. To Him belongs the dominion; He is the Master of the Day of Judgement and the Sovereign of creation, the absolute Owner.
asmaallah_desc.4: He is the Pure, free from every flaw and deficiency and beyond all that minds can comprehend.
asmaallah_desc.5: He is the One who spreads peace among mankind, and whose Essence is free from deficiency, flaw and extinction.
asmaallah_desc.6: He is the One who keeps His allies safe from His punishment, and who fulfils for His servants what He has promised them.
asmaallah_desc.7: He is the Watcher and Preserver of all things, who maintains His creation with their deeds, provisions and life spans, and who is responsible for their care, protection and safekeeping.
asmaallah_desc.8: He is the One unique in might, the Prevailing who cannot be overcome, the Strong and Invulnerable whom nothing defeats while He prevails over everything.
asmaallah_desc.9: He is the One whose will is carried out; no one escapes His decree, and He compels His creation according to what He wills.
asmaallah_desc.10: He is the One exalted above the attributes of creation, unique in greatness and supremacy.
asmaallah_desc.11: He is the Originator and Inventor of all things, who determines them and brings them into existence from nothing; He is the Creator of every maker and what he makes.
asmaallah_desc.12: He is the One who created creation by His power without any previous model, able to bring into existence what He has decreed.
asmaallah_desc.13: He is the One who gave form to all that exists and arranged it, giving each thing its own particular form and unique shape by which it is distinguished despite their diversity and great number.
asmaallah_desc.14: He alone is the One who forgives sins and conceals faults in this world and the Hereafter.
asmaallah_desc.15: He is the Prevailing, who has subdued His creation by His authority and power and directed them as He wills, willingly or unwillingly; everything submits to His majesty.
asmaallah_desc.16: He is the One who bestows blessings upon His servants, who gives without compensation and grants needs without being asked, abundant in blessings and constant in giving.
asmaallah_desc.17: He is the One who created all provisions and gave every creature its provision; He supplies every being with what it needs, preserves its life and sets it right.
asmaallah_desc.18: He is the One who opens what is closed and makes easy what is difficult; in His hand are the keys of the heavens and the earth.
asmaallah_desc.19: He is the One who knows the details of all matters, the subtleties of things and the secrets of hearts and souls. Not even the weight of an atom escapes His dominion; His knowledge encompasses all things.
asmaallah_desc.20: He is the One who withholds provision from whomever He wills of His creation, by His justice.
asmaallah_desc.21: The One who expands provision for whomever He wills of His servants, by His generosity and mercy; glorified is He, the Withholder and the Extender.
asmaallah_desc.22: He is the One who abases and humiliates everyone who transgresses, behaves tyrannically, departs from His law and rebels.
asmaallah_desc.23: He is the One who raises His believing servants through acts of obedience, and He is the One who raised the heavens.
asmaallah_desc.24: He is the One who grants strength, victory and might to whomever He wills, and so honours him.
asmaallah_desc.25: He is the One who grants strength, victory and might to whomever He wills and so honours him, and takes them away from whomever He wills and so humiliates him.
asmaallah_desc.26: He is the One from whom nothing on earth or in heaven is hidden, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
asmaallah_desc.27: He is the One who sees all things, outward and inward, and encompasses everything that can be seen.
asmaallah_desc.28: He is the One who judges between His creatures as He wills and distinguishes between truth and falsehood; none can repel His decree and none can overturn His judgement.
asmaallah_desc.29: He is the One who has forbidden injustice for Himself and made it forbidden among His servants. He is free from injustice and oppression in His rulings and actions, and gives everyone their due right.
asmaallah_desc.30: He is the Kind and Gentle towards His servants: He provides for them, makes things easy for them, does good to them, is gentle with them and bestows His favour upon them.
asmaallah_desc.31: He is the One who knows the subtleties of all matters; nothing hidden escapes Him and nothing is absent from His knowledge. He knows what has been and what will be.
asmaallah_desc.32: He is the Patient One who gives respite but does not neglect, who conceals sins and delays punishment, providing for the disobedient as He provides for the obedient.
asmaallah_desc.33: He is the One whose greatness has no beginning and whose majesty has no end; there is nothing like Him.
asmaallah_desc.34: He is the One who covers the sins of His servants and pardons their errors and sins.
asmaallah_desc.35: He is the One with whom the little of His servants' deeds grows, so He multiplies their reward; and His thanks to His servants is His forgiveness of them.
asmaallah_desc.36: He is the One of lofty status whom the descriptions of those who describe cannot encompass, exalted above all equals and opposites. Every meaning of highness belongs to Him: in His Essence, in His dominance and in His rank.
asmaallah_desc.37: He is the Great and Majestic, possessor of supremacy in His attributes and actions; He needs nothing and nothing is beyond His power. (There is nothing like Him.)
asmaallah_desc.38: He is the One from whose preservation nothing escapes, even the weight of an atom; His preservation does not change, cease or alter.
asmaallah_desc.39: He is the One who guarantees to deliver to creation their sustenance; He is the Preserver, the Powerful, the Able, the Determiner and the Supplier.
asmaallah_desc.40: He is the All-Sufficient, from whom comes the sufficiency of His servants and upon whom they rely; He suffices His servants by His bounty.
asmaallah_desc.41: He is the absolutely Great, characterised by all attributes of perfection and described by their perfection, free from every deficiency.
asmaallah_desc.42: He is the One abundant in good, the Generous Giver whose giving never runs out. He is absolutely Generous, combining all kinds of goodness, honour and virtue, praised for His actions.
asmaallah_desc.43: He is the Watcher who observes the states of His servants, knows their words and records their deeds; He is the Preserver from whom nothing is absent.
asmaallah_desc.44: He is the One who meets supplication and requests with giving and acceptance; none other than Him is to be asked.
asmaallah_desc.45: He is the One whose provision extends to all His creation and whose mercy encompasses all things; He encompasses everything.
asmaallah_desc.46: He is the One who is right in His management, subtle in His decrees, aware of the realities of all matters, knowing in His wise determination; all His creation and decree are goodness, wisdom and justice.
asmaallah_desc.47: He is the One who loves His servants and who is loved in the hearts of His allies.
asmaallah_desc.48: He is the One who has attained the utmost glory, abundant in kindness, generous in giving and great in goodness.
asmaallah_desc.49: He is the One who will resurrect creation on the Day of Resurrection, who sends His messengers to the servants, and who sends help to the servant.
asmaallah_desc.50: He is the Ever-Present from whom nothing is absent; He is aware of everything, witnessing it and knowing its details.
asmaallah_desc.51: He is the One who establishes the truth by His words and supports His allies; He alone is worthy of worship.
asmaallah_desc.52: He is the Guarantor of creation who manages their affairs. Whoever relies on Him, He takes care of him and suffices him; and whoever seeks sufficiency through Him, He enriches him and satisfies him.
asmaallah_desc.53: He is the Possessor of complete power, perfect in every way, the Prevailing who is never overcome; His strength is above every strength.
asmaallah_desc.54: He is the Mighty One who needs no soldiers, reinforcements or helpers to carry out His decree.
asmaallah_desc.55: He is the One who loves and supports those who obey Him. He aids His allies and subdues His enemies, and He manages the affairs of creation and preserves them.
asmaallah_desc.56: He is the One worthy of all praise and commendation, the One besides whom none is praised in adversity.
asmaallah_desc.57: He is the One who has enumerated everything by His knowledge; nothing small or great escapes Him.
asmaallah_desc.58: He is the One who brought things into being and invented them from the beginning without any previous model.
asmaallah_desc.59: He is the One who returns creation from life to death in this world, and from death to life on the Day of Resurrection.
asmaallah_desc.60: He is the Creator of life who gives it to whomever He wills; He brings creation to life from nothing, then gives them life again after death.
asmaallah_desc.61: He is the One who decrees death for everyone He causes to die, and there is no causer of death besides Him; He subdues His servants with death whenever and however He wills.
asmaallah_desc.62: He is the One characterised by eternal life that has no beginning and no end; He remains forever, without beginning and without end, the Ever-Living who does not die.
asmaallah_desc.63: He is the Self-Subsisting, independent of all others, who maintains and manages the affairs of His creation in creating them and providing for them.
asmaallah_desc.64: He is the One who lacks nothing and whom nothing is beyond; He finds all that He seeks and attains all that He wills.
asmaallah_desc.65: He is the One who possesses infinite perfection and resplendent might, might in His attributes and actions, who treats His servants with generosity and mercy.
asmaallah_desc.66: He is the Single One, unique in His Essence, attributes and actions; One in His dominion with none to contest it. He has no partner, glorified is He.
asmaallah_desc.67: He has no partner, glorified is He.
asmaallah_desc.68: He is the One who is obeyed, without whom no matter is decided, and to whom all turn in their needs; He is the One to whom His servants turn in the important affairs of their religion and their worldly life.
asmaallah_desc.69: He is the One able to bring into existence what does not exist and to cause what exists to cease, in the measure that wisdom requires, neither more nor less.
asmaallah_desc.70: He is the One able to set creation right in a way that none other is able to.
asmaallah_desc.71: He is the One who brings things forward and puts them in their proper places; whoever deserves to be brought forward, He brings forward.
asmaallah_desc.72: He is the One who puts things back and places them in their proper places; He delays whomever He wills of the wicked, the disbelievers and all who deserve to be put back.
asmaallah_desc.73: He is the One whom nothing preceded in existence; He is First before all existence.
asmaallah_desc.74: He is the One who remains after His creation perishes; His permanence is eternal. Everything perishes and permanence belongs to Him alone, so there is nothing after Him.
asmaallah_desc.75: He is the One who is above all things and exalted over them, whose existence is manifest through the abundance of its signs.
asmaallah_desc.76: He is the One who knows the inner and hidden aspects of all matters, and He is closer to us than our jugular vein.
asmaallah_desc.77: He is the Owner of all things, who disposes of them by His will and wisdom, whose command is carried out in them and whose judgement prevails over them.
asmaallah_desc.78: He is the One far above the lies of the fabricators and free from the misgivings of the bewildered.
asmaallah_desc.79: He is the One who is kind to His servants through His goodness and gentleness, who favours those who ask with His excellent giving, and who is true in what He promises.
asmaallah_desc.80: He is the One who grants His servants success in repenting so that He may turn to them and accept their repentance; He meets supplication with giving, and repentance with forgiveness of sins.
asmaallah_desc.81: He is the One who breaks the backs of tyrants and is severe in punishing the disobedient — and that only after excuses have been removed and warnings given.
asmaallah_desc.82: He is the One who forgoes taking account of sins and does not remind you of your faults; He erases bad deeds and overlooks acts of disobedience.
asmaallah_desc.83: He is the One who is compassionate to sinners by accepting their repentance, who is generous with His kindness and gracious with His compassion; He conceals faults and then pardons them.
asmaallah_desc.84: He is the One who disposes of His dominion as He wills; none can repel His judgement and none can overturn His command.
asmaallah_desc.85: He is the One unique in the attributes of majesty, perfection and greatness, to whom alone belong generosity and honour, and who is worthy of being glorified.
asmaallah_desc.86: He is the Just in His judgement, who takes the due of the oppressed from the oppressor, then completes His justice by satisfying the oppressor after satisfying the oppressed.
asmaallah_desc.87: He is the One who combines all perfections in Essence, attributes and actions; who gathers together creatures both alike and different; and who will gather the first and the last.
asmaallah_desc.88: He is the One who needs nothing, independent of all besides Him, while all others are in need of Him.
asmaallah_desc.89: He is the Giver of wealth to His servants; He enriches whomever He wills, and He suffices whomever He wills of His servants.
asmaallah_desc.90: He withholds giving from whomever He wills, as a test or as a protection.
asmaallah_desc.91: He is the One who decrees harm upon whomever He wills, however He wills.
asmaallah_desc.92: The One who decrees benefit and good for whomever He wills, however He wills — all of this according to the requirements of His wisdom, glorified is He.
asmaallah_desc.93: He is the Guide who directs by His guidance whomever He wills, making the truth clear to him and inspiring him to follow it; manifest in Himself and making other things manifest.
asmaallah_desc.94: He is the One who shows creation the path of truth by His words; He guides hearts to knowing Him and souls to obeying Him.
asmaallah_desc.95: He is the One whom none resembles in His attributes, in any of His judgements or in any of His affairs; He is the Originator who brings into existence without any previous model.
asmaallah_desc.96: He alone possesses permanence; He is ever-existing, characterised by eternal permanence, not subject to extinction, the Everlasting without end.
asmaallah_desc.97: He is the Everlasting and Eternal who inherits all creatures after creation perishes; He inherits the earth and all who are on it.
asmaallah_desc.98: He is the One who makes happy whomever He wills by His guidance and makes wretched whomever He wills by distancing him; great in wisdom and perfect in right guidance.
asmaallah_desc.99: He is the Forbearing who does not hasten to punish the disobedient, but rather pardons and delays, and does not hasten any action before its time.

tasbih.1: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things.
tasbih.2: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, and Allah is Most Great.
tasbih.3: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.
tasbih.4: There is no god but You; glory be to You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
tasbih.8: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
tasbih.9: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, besides whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I turn to Him in repentance.
tasbih.10: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty and turn to Him in repentance.
tasbih.11: I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and what I fear.
tasbih.12: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
